changes.release_notes:
Scan your clothes, share anything into Essembl, and see all your looks in one place.

• Scan your clothes: tap the shutter for each piece, or hold to film and say the brand. Each one is cut out in seconds and lands in your wardrobe.
• Share to Essembl: share a photo or a link from TikTok, Pinterest, Safari or any app. Add it to your closet, find it in shops or rate the look.
• Your looks, in one place: every outfit check and glow-up, each photo cut out, in Wardrobe › Looks.
• A new + button: add clothes, rate your look or get outfit ideas from anywhere.
• Rate my look: the detailed rating is back, with style, colour, texture and fit.
• Smarter outfits: better layering (a base, a layer, then a jacket when it’s needed) and more variety.
• Rate the AI’s ideas: thumbs up or down on Studio ideas, and tell us what’s off.

Plus lots of fixes and polish.
